phrase: Computer science enrollment is dropping as AI takes over entry-level coding jobs. Meanwhile, new malware uses AI to rank hacking victims by how much they are worth.
phraseAlternatives: Fewer students are studying computer science now that AI fills the entry-level jobs. New malware, powered by AI, ranks victims by their net worth before stealing from them.
Young people are leaving computer science as AI absorbs the jobs they trained for. Elsewhere, AI-driven malware decides which victims are rich enough to rob.
Computer science is losing students to AI-driven job losses. At the same time, new malware uses AI to pick its richest victims first.
alt: A worried student sits beside a teal robot wearing a "New Hire" tag in an empty classroom seat. Across a dividing line, a red hooded robot raises a magnifying glass over a fan of dollar-marked cards, one glowing brighter and tagged "Top Target".

brief.concept: A classroom of computer-science students thins out as a robot settles into the empty entry-level desk beside them, while elsewhere a hooded robot sorts through victim profile cards to pick its richest target.
brief.metaphor: The field that trains people to build AI is the same field AI is now emptying out, right next to AI using that same cleverness to pick its prey by wealth.
